executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
Execute all backend tests aiming for 100% functional coverage. 
1. ELIGIBILITY: Test active/inactive members, active/expired/cancelled policies, waiting periods (met/unmet), and annual limits (remaining vs spent).
2. PRICING: Verify Provider Contract rates vs Master Catalog fallback.
3. CLAIMS: Test full lifecycle from Draft to Settled.
4. NEGATIVE CASES: Invalid status, unauthorized provider, and service date outside policy range.
Report all failures clearly with reason codes.
